title: IoT Developer Roadmap
summary: Build software and embedded-systems fundamentals, then combine sensors, microcontrollers, networking, cloud platforms and device security to create reliable connected products.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a four-year B.Tech/B.E. programme beginning in 2026 and graduation around 2030. Shift the years if your actual programme duration differs.

blocks.text: 4-year honours variant

If you choose a four-year honours route, use the additional year for advanced embedded systems, edge AI, industrial IoT, device security, wireless protocols, research or an extended industry project. The honours year is not automatically required for an entry-level IoT Developer role.

blocks.label: Evolve and stay relevant, 2035–2046
blocks.text: Move from building individual connected devices toward designing complete connected systems. Develop depth in edge computing, device lifecycle management, IoT security, industrial connectivity, cloud architecture and edge AI.

blocks.text: PhD routes

Senior IoT professionals can remain relevant by moving from device-level development into connected-system architecture, edge computing, industrial IoT, device security and edge AI. Maintain hands-on understanding of hardware, connectivity and cloud systems while developing the ability to design reliable systems across the complete device lifecycle.
